import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 33;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] mat = new long[N][N];
        int size;

        void clear() {
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
                Arrays.fill(mat[i], 0);
        }

        void identity() {
            clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
                mat[i][i] = 1;
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix b) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix();
            res.size = size;
            res.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < size; k++) {
                        res.mat[i][j] = (res.mat[i][j] + mat[i][k] * b.mat[k][j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static long readLong(Scanner sc) {
        return sc.nextLong();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = readLong(sc);
        long K = readLong(sc);
        int r = (int) (K + 1);

        List<Matrix> baseOne = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Matrix> baseTwo = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Matrix> rotRight = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Matrix> rotLeft = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
            Matrix m = new Matrix();
            m.size = r;
            m.clear();
            for (int j = 0; j < r; j++) {
                m.mat[i][j] = 1;
            }
            if (i > 0) {
                for (int j = 0; j < r; j++) {
                    m.mat[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
            baseOne.add(m);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
            Matrix m = new Matrix();
            m.size = r;
            m.clear();
            if (i == 1) {
                m.mat[0][0] = 1;
                m.mat[1][K] = 1;
                for (int j = 2; j <= K; j++) {
                    m.mat[j][j - 1] = 1;
                }
            } else if (i > 1) {
                m = rotRight.get(1).multiply(rotRight.get(i - 1));
            } else {
                m.identity();
            }
            rotRight.add(m);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
            Matrix m = new Matrix();
            m.size = r;
            m.clear();
            if (i == 1) {
                m.mat[0][0] = 1;
                m.mat[K][1] = 1;
                for (int j = 2; j <= K; j++) {
                    m.mat[j - 1][j] = 1;
                }
            } else if (i > 1) {
                m = rotLeft.get(i - 1).multiply(rotLeft.get(1));
            } else {
                m.identity();
            }
            rotLeft.add(m);
        }

        Matrix baseTwoOne = new Matrix();
        baseTwoOne.size = r;
        baseTwoOne.identity();
        for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
            baseTwoOne = baseOne.get((int) i).multiply(baseTwoOne);
        }
        baseTwo.add(null); // index 0 unused
        baseTwo.add(baseTwoOne);

        // For indices >= 2
        for (int i = 2; i < 100; i++) {
            Matrix m = new Matrix();
            m.size = r;
            m.identity();
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                m = rotRight.get(j).multiply(m);
                m = baseTwo.get(i - 1).multiply(m);
                m = rotLeft.get(j).multiply(m);
                m = baseTwo.get(i - 1).multiply(m);
            }
            baseTwo.add(m);
        }

        Matrix result = new Matrix();
        result.size = r;
        result.identity();

        List<Long> num = new ArrayList<>();
        long tempN = n;
        while (tempN > 0) {
            num.add(tempN % K);
            tempN /= K;
        }
        Collections.reverse(num);

        int position = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < num.size(); i++) {
            long count = num.get(i);
            if (i == num.size() - 1) {
                for (long j = 0; j < count; j++) {
                    result = baseOne.get(position % K + 1).multiply(result);
                    position++;
                }
            } else {
                for (long j = 0; j < count; j++) {
                    Matrix tempMat = rotRight.get(position % K);
                    Matrix tempMat2 = baseTwo.get(num.size() - i - 2);
                    Matrix tempMat3 = rotLeft.get(position % K);
                    result = tempMat.multiply(tempMat2).multiply(tempMat3).multiply(result);
                    position++;
                }
            }
        }

        long answer = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < r; j++) {
                answer = (answer + result.mat[i][0]) % MOD;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(answer % MOD);
        sc.close();
    }
}
